sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Slightly peel off the cucumber skin, remove the seeds and cut into 1/2 inch cubes.
Using the back of the cleaver, lightly pound the radishes.
Sprinkle the salt over the cucumber and radish mixture and set aside for 30 minutes.
Pour off the water from the cucumber and radish mixture. Pour the dressing mixture over the salad, toss it, and chill for 30 minutes before serving.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Shred radish into long strips and sprinkle with 1 tsp salt, toss. Let sit for 15 minutes. Squeeze water out and set aside.
Saute sausage until flavor comes out. Mix in with the radish.
Mix outside dough and chill for 10 minutes; mix inside dough and chill for 10 minutes.
Divide each dough into 20 small pieces; roll out into 3" circle, putting inside dough on top, roll up. Roll out again into 3" circle, put about 1 TB filling in center and fold.
Fry over medium heat in about 1/2 inch oil til brown on each side. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Add hot water to the flour in a bowl and mix well. If necessary, add a touch of cold water and knead well then set aside for 15 minutes.

Divide the dough into 8 pieces and roll them out into 5 inch round pancakes. Brush mixture A onto the top of the pan cake and roll it up. Now use a rolling pin to roll the dough out into a thin pancake.
Using medium heat and 4 TBS oil, pan fry each pancake on both sides until brown and crispy. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Soak 1 cup of dried soy beans in 10 cups of water for more than 6 hours. Wash and rinse the beans once.

Put the beans in a blender with 4 cups of water and turn on the chop cycle until the beans are finely chopped. Pour the puree through a fine cheese cloth and add 6 more cups of water to the cloth to rinse through. Bring the soy bean milk to a boil and reduce heat and let simmer for 5 minutes and it is ready to serve with or without the scallion pizzas. For sweet soy bean milk add sugar to taste.

title: Eight Treasure Delight with Bean Sauce

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the pork into 1/2 inch cubes and marinate in sauce 1 for 15 minutes.
Use 2 TB oil to stir-fry the pork; add the rest of the ingredients one at a time (except the peanuts). Cook together for a short time and remove to the side.
Use one TB oil to stir-fry sauce 2 until the flavor comes out. Add sauce 3; then add the cooked ingredients and the peanuts. Mix well and serve hot.

title: Stuffed Pepper with Black Bean Sauce

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut green pepper into 1 inch squares.
Mix pork, shrimp (both), sauce A together to make stuffing.
Powder green pepper with cornstarch; stuff each piece with stuffing. Powder again all over with cornstarch.
Pan fry the peppers meat side down in a hot skillet for one minute. Remove to the side.
Use 2 TB oil in wok. Saute sauce B til the flavor comes out; add sauce C and let simmer til it becomes glazed and smooth.
Pour the sauce over the peppers and place the plate on a steam tray in wok and steam for three minutes. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Sprinkle the salt over the cabbage, toss it, and marinate for 4 hours.
Use your hands to squeeze the liquid out of the cabbage and then place it in a serving bowl. Top with A ingredients.

Heat the sesame oil in a pan and then add the sugar and vinegar and cook until the sugar dissolves. Pour the mixture over the cabbage and quickly toss the cabbage and then cover and refrigerate for 4 hours before serving cold. This dish will keep for weeks in the refrigerator and can be served at any time in place of a pickle or relish dish.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Deep fry the bean curd sticks in hot oil then remove to boiling water and cook for 2-3 minutes. Remove from the water and cut into 1-inch lengths.
Use 3 TBS oil to brown the garlic. Add all the vegetables, add the soup stock and the seasoning and cook until the liquid is reduced.
Add the sesame seed oil and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Wash eggplant, do not peel but cut off top and bottom as needed. Cut eggplant lengthwise into 3/8-inch thick slices. Then cut slices in 3/8-inch wide and 2-inch lengths.
Bring large pot of water to a boil. Cook cut-up eggplant til tender. Drain thoroughly.
Mix marinade ingredients and pour over drained eggplant, thoroughly coating and refrigerate for several hours.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Peel the skin off the eggplants and cut into 1 inch sticks.
Deep fry the eggplant in hot oil and drain well.
Stir-fry the pork and remove to the side.
Use 1 TB oil to stir-fry sauce A. Add sauce B and bring to a boil. Add the eggplant and the pork. Simmer for two minutes and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 medium size egg plants cut into thin strips

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Use medium low heat to stir fry the egg plant with 3-4 TBS oil until the egg plant becomes soft. Remove from the heat.
Brown mixture A until the flavor comes out. Add the hot bean sauce and mixture B and bring it to a boil. Add the egg plant.
Add mixture C, heat momentarily and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Cook
items: Heat 3 TBS oil in the wok and brown the dry shrimp and ginger.
Add cabbage and stir fry in a very hot wok.
Add chicken broth, (A) seasonings, and mushrooms and cover the wok and cook for a short time until the cabbage becomes soft.
Arrange the cabbage on a platter, pour the liquid, mushrooms, and shrimp back into the wok, add (B) mixture to thicken the sauce, then pour the sauce over the cabbage and serve hot.
